title: Reading Drill — Recording seasonal light for a mural — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Recording seasonal light for a mural — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The mural planner in Ravensmere received an old report about paint colours looking different across the same wall. The report compared colour differences at set hours, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the photographic comparisons rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered nine weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include nearby buildings casting shadows. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a test of sample panels in place as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
